purpose: Pre-registered test of specialist S4's hypothesis for the 6.3 nm ON-STATE SHAPE miss (tuned run_0015 / B2: Vth_lin-Vth_cc gap too small by ~0.35 V, gm_max -23 %): an extra ~2e12 cm^-2 of acceptor-like states within ~1 kT of Ec plus a higher band mobility. Deck: tuned 6.3 nm configuration at DOS 384/192 (baseline B2_dos384_6p3) with the bulk acceptor Gaussian replaced by NGA = 2e12/(6.3e-7 x 0.02 x sqrt(pi)) = 9.0e19 cm^-3 eV^-1, EGA = 0.03 eV below Ec, WGA = 0.02 eV, and mu_band 15.4 (S4 surrogate). Qf is NOT refitted in ATLAS: a Qf change is an exact rigid shift (runs 0001->0003, 0005->0007), so the shape metrics (gap, gm_max, SS_cc) are read directly and Vth_cc is corrected analytically. S4 PREDICTION recorded before the run (0-D surrogate, relative to run_0015): gap +0.28 V, gm_max +24 %, SS_cc +23 mV/dec. S1's competing expectation for gap-state bands (1-D): the gap does not open without SS_cc rising well above the measured 295 mV/dec. Approximation: in the 0.25 nm interface layer the band is moment-matched with the interface sheet (generator), and the assumed deep Gaussian (5e16 at Ec-0.6 eV, insensitive) is replaced. 2026-09-25.
